entries.title: Dinosaur Game

primary.why: The Dinosaur Game is built into Chrome's network-error/offline resources, so the authentic route is a current Chrome/Chromium browser rather than a clone website. Browser version and device input define the archived state.
primary.how_to_play: Use Chrome's offline error page or chrome://dino. Record browser version, OS/device, input method, online/offline state, high score, and any accessibility or speed-affecting settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record Chrome/Chromium version and avoid substituting clone sites for the built-in game.
